title: Assess multi-block Forms locally before AI design
changes: Extract and assess FMB or Forms XML locally, including multiple blocks and normal business SQL.
See all observed blocks/items, trigger counts, source identity/locations and review requirements.
Assessment stays local and cannot authorize AI submission, generation, import or source handoff.
Changed original, readable or assessment bytes revoke the displayed facts.
The UI distinguishes observed facts from OPAF understanding, which has not run in this assessment step.
limitations: This increment adds broad local assessment, not broad OPAF understanding or multi-block native generation.
Raw FMB extraction requires configured Oracle Forms tooling in the authenticated localhost application.
The existing hosted intake and narrow generation profiles are unchanged; no live model switch is implied.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
